propositions: Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) currently have no truthful administrative exit path; only bugs can close with duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated, forcing operators to use --force for ~25 ADMINISTRATIVE-disposition closes observed in 7-day audit
The completion-FAIL message does not enumerate the valid --class values for a given ticket type, leaving operators unaware of administrative disposition alternatives
obsolete and wontfix classes require a reason but the --reason flag is currently force-only, with no path to carry non-forced reasons into the ticket state

Replacement-bearing administrative classes (duplicate, superseded) and reason-only classes (obsolete, wontfix) must skip completion verification (AC/file-impact/billable checks) and return directly from precheck
reason-only administrative disposition closes must mint signed attestations carrying the class+reason line in the manifest, preventing unsigned-close violations

The write-side vocabulary (CLOSE_CLASSES, CloseClass enum, disposition enums, schema definitions) and enforcement gates (txn.transition_core, close_precheck) must stay synchronized via drift-guard tests
